title: EvidenceReference
description: The minimal, citation-only subset of the platform-owned telemetry_evidence contract that LLM roles (red, blue) are permitted to embed. A reference points at evidence held in the platform evidence store; it is NOT the evidence itself. Model claims are never evidence.

evidence_id.description: Immutable id of a verified evidence record in the platform evidence store.

evidence_type.description: Kind of verified evidence being referenced.

provenance_ref.description: Optional pointer to the evidence source/provenance (e.g. evidence_store path).
